Silas in jail, Acts 16. A midnight song in stocks, and an earthquake, and doors that opened, and a jailer, what must I do to be saved, and believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and his house, too. The gospel can turn a prison into a place of praise. If you are in a tight place, you can still sing true words to God, and He is able to do more than a locked door, He can set a life free, starting with a soul.
